blocks.text: Pete Apolinar of the ZIP Sanman Boxing Team shocked Japan after dethroning Shunpei Ohata to capture the World Boxing Organization (WBO) Asia Pacific super featherweight title via a ninth-round technical knockout (TKO) on Saturday, September 26, in Shizuoka, Japan. ...
